name: Data Story
summary: One real chart drawn mark by mark on cream dot-grid paper by a red-blue pencil, one number at a time: a Newsreader headline, handwritten notes pinned to the data, a colour ramp that encodes the value only, and a figure caption under a hairline rule.
suits: any series or ranking with a human angle

palette.use: the paper, with fixed-seed fibre noise
ink: axes, series line, headline, caption, dot rings
red pencil lead: records, the one number, the turn
diverging ramp, cold end: data values only

type.emphasis: pencil lead colour (blue notes, red records), an un-closed ring round the mark, a position pinned in data space

banned: a dashboard: one idea at a time
a keynote with chart slides, or a chart as decoration
changing a number, extrapolating, or a value without a source or formula
stretching a colour ramp for drama: pale values stay pale
colour that means anything but the value (notes keep their lead colours)
fades to blank or dissolves: transitions are chart operations
captions over a chart operation or a silence
copying any data storyteller's or newspaper's charts, layouts or typefaces, or naming them

sources.what: Lemo-Opuscar style No. 23 "Data Storytelling" (STYLE.md, DEMO.md, style.json), via research notes
sources.where: github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar styles/dataviz; docs/research/styles/five-skills.md, section "Data Storytelling (pencil chart on cream paper)"
